title: StoryPointEstimationInput
description: Schema to guide effort estimation using Story Point Estimation technique. Captures story-based inputs and defines rules to map effort, complexity, and risk into structured outputs.

projectType.description: The domain or nature of the software project.

projectScale.description: Indicates the size and breadth of the project.

timeConstraint.description: Timeframe for delivery or development window.

estimatedModules.description: Number of modules (epics) to be generated. Mapped from project scale.

effortRangeHours.description: Minimum and maximum total effort across all modules in hours.

columnDefinitions.description: Specifies the structure of each row in the output story table.

default.description: Functional domain grouping related user stories.
Feature or functionality expressed from a user's perspective.
Abstract relative measure of effort and complexity (typically Fibonacci numbers).
Technical or business complexity of the story.
Nature of the task. E.g., 'UI Enhancement', 'New Feature', 'API Call', 'Bug Fix'.
Estimated risk based on complexity, unknowns, or external dependencies.
Overall estimation of effort type, correlated with story points and complexity.

mappingsAndRules.description: Logical rules and ranges to guide story point assignment, risk mapping, and complexity handling.

scaleToEpicCount.description: Maps project scale to a fixed number of epics. The LLM should generate only this number of epics for a given scale. If the natural number of epics exceeds this count, similar ones must be merged or combined to meet the target.

scaleToStoryPointTotal.description: Defines the permissible range for total story points estimates based on the project scale. LLM must ensure the total estimated story points falls within this range.

storyPointAssignmentRules: 1–2 SP for trivial changes like minor UI tweaks or text fixes
3–5 SP for standard CRUD operations or one-screen forms
8–13 SP for integrations, multi-step workflows, or backend logic
21 SP for complex or cross-cutting stories affecting multiple systems
complexityDerivationRules: Low if story points are 1–3 and classification is 'UI Enhancement' or 'Bug Fix'
Medium if story points are 5–8 and classification involves logic or data manipulation
High if story points >= 13 or classification involves third-party systems or security-critical paths
riskMappingRules: Low if complexity is Low and classification is 'UI Enhancement'
Medium if complexity is Medium or story depends on integration or calculation
High if complexity is High or story involves unknown APIs, external systems, or migrations

userStoryFormatRule.const: User stories must follow the format: 'As a [user role], I want to [action] so that [benefit]'
